title: Emissary of the Demonic Path
next_chapter_hook: The yellowed secret letter lay quietly in Ye Qing's palm, and the familiar handwriting made Chen Ji's breath hitch—his father had calculated this day eighteen years ago, and his contingencies extended far beyond this.

text.content: The moment his fingertips touched the Turtle Shell, a warm current surged into his palm from his father's presence—a protection spanning eighteen years, waiting to be awakened. The fine cracks on the Turtle Shell seemed to come alive, forming golden patterns that wound across Chen Ji's palm—those were the unique sealing marks of the Tianji Record Fragment. Within the warmth was a tinge of desolation, as if his father was nodding to him across the endless years. Chen Ji gripped the Turtle Shell tightly, his knuckles white, throat churning. Eighteen years—this was the only thing his father left him.

However, this tranquility was shattered by a soft sound. 'Clack,' the window lattice rang, Chen Ji's eyes turned cold, and his spiritual sense instantly swept out—only to see a ghostly purple figure standing beneath the moonlight, robes fluttering without wind, surrounded by a faint mist of the Demonic Path. The visitor's features were delicate as a painting, yet her eyes carried a sharp edge. She was precisely the Holy Sect's Saint—Ye Qing. Her lips carried an indiscernible smile as her gaze fell upon the golden-glowing Turtle Shell in Chen Ji's hand, her expression shifting. 'Interesting,' she murmured, 'The seven-day agreement, you've kept your word.' Chen Ji calmly concealed the Turtle Shell into his sleeve, his expression unchanged, only a flicker of vigilance passing through his eyes' depths—how did she penetrate the Tianqing Sect's barrier?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked forward slowly, the Demonic Path mist spreading beneath her feet, enveloping this confined space in isolation. She raised her hand, and a ghostly light shot out, condensing into a curtain of light between the two. Within the light appeared the vast and mighty Demonic Path army, banners blocking the sun, murderous aura soaring to the heavens. At the very front of the army, a blood-red commander's banner flew high, bearing a shocking character 'Chen.' 'See it clearly?' Ye Qing's voice carried a solemn weight, 'The Demonic Path army's commander is no one else, but the descendant of your father Chen Xuan's successor—Chen Tianming.' In the light curtain, that towering figure slowly turned, revealing a face bearing three-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, yet with burning mad ambition deep in those eyes.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at that familiar yet strange face, his pupils slightly constricting. Chen Tianming—this name was not unfamiliar to him. His father's notes had mentioned this person—the one who had been equally brilliant and a competitor when his father was chosen by the Tianji Record. However, the Tianji Record chose his father, and Chen Tianming defected from the righteous path in rage, joining the Demonic Path, then disappeared for many years. Now he returns at the head of the Demonic Path army, with the primary target being—to destroy the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji's heart sank; he suddenly understood something. His father's past entanglement with the Demonic Path ran far deeper than he imagined. And he, this 'useless' son, seemed to have been drawn into this chess game spanning three generations from birth.

dialogue.content: 'The seven-day agreement, I'm here.' Ye Qing's voice interrupted Chen Ji's thoughts. She reached into her怀中, producing a yellowed silk scroll and a sealed letter. The scroll was ancient and heavy, bearing golden patterns similar to those on the Turtle Shell—that was the aura of a Tianji Record Fragment. And the fire-seal on the letter bore the Chen family's ancestral flying dragon insignia. 'These are your father's legacy,' Ye Qing handed the two items to Chen Ji, her gaze complex, 'He foresaw today's situation eighteen years ago and specially entrusted our Holy Sect to preserve them until now. Chen Ji... your father was far more deeply calculating than you could imagine.' Under the moonlight, a hint of imperceptible compassion flickered in Ye Qing's eyes.

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the silk scroll and letter, his fingertips trembling slightly. The moment the scroll touched his palm, the Tianji Record's aura surged violently, and an information stream flooded into his Mental Sea like a tide—the method to unseal the second page of the Tianji Record, along with his father's voice: 'My son, if you see this page, it means your father has already passed from this world. Chen Tianming was your father's sworn enemy; his ambition extends far beyond dominating the Demonic Path. What he wants... is the Tianji Record itself. Remember, this person is extremely treacherous, absolutely do not confront him directly.' The voice cut off abruptly, yet Chen Ji could not calm himself for a long time. His father had calculated this day eighteen years ago, even arranging who would entrust the legacy. The 'Holy Sect' in Ye Qing's words actually had such a connection with his father?

dialogue.content: 'You must have many questions.' Ye Qing said softly. She raised her hand and recalled the Demonic Path mist, allowing moonlight to fall upon this confined space once more. 'The connection between me and your father is a long story. He once saved my life, and I owe him a debt of gratitude. For seventeen years, the Holy Sect has been secretly searching for his descendants. It was not until three months ago that I finally confirmed your identity.' She paused, her expression grave, 'But what I didn't expect was that Chen Tianming was one step ahead of me. He knows you're still alive, knows you have the Tianji Record Fragment. The attack on the Tianqing Sect, superficially to destroy the three major sects, but in reality...' Her gaze sharpened, 'It's for you.'

text.content: Chen Ji unsealed the letter, familiar handwriting appearing before his eyes. The letter was short, yet each word carried immense weight: 'My son Ji. If you can read this letter, it means your father has departed, and the world will descend into chaos. Chen Tianming—I know him deeply. He has been pursuing the Tianji Record for over half his life, and this return must have ulterior motives. Your father left a flaw in the Tianji Record—the third page requires your blood to unseal, and this is the key to victory. Additionally, Nian is still alive, in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds; your father has already paved the way for you. Remember: do not confront Tianming directly; outwit him is the priority. From your father.' Chen Ji's eyes instantly reddened—Nian—his long-missing sister had actually been hidden by his father in the Holy Sect all along!

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing his emotions. His father indeed calculated everything perfectly, even arranging his sister's whereabouts. But he understood more clearly—this letter was both guidance and a test. His father was telling him this way: the chess game had long been set up, and what he needed to do was complete this game. However, Ye Qing's news did not end there. She produced a Jade Slip from her sleeve, her expression solemn: 'There's one more thing. Ling Yuan—the old Sect Master you speak of—has secretly colluded with Chen Tianming. During the Sect Competition three days from now, he will personally hand you over to the Demonic Path.' Within the Jade Slip appeared images of their secret meeting; Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned cold.

dialogue.content: 'Ling Yuan...' Ye Qing coldly laughed, 'Do you really think he genuinely took you in? A failure abandoned by the Tianji Record, waiting seventeen years for a chance to turn the tables. He thought collaborating with Chen Tianming would regain the Tianji Record's recognition, never knowing he was merely the other party's chess piece.' She tossed the Jade Slip to Chen Ji, 'This intelligence was obtained by me at the risk of exposure, considered fulfilling the promise to your father. But what you do next is your own affair.' Ye Qing's figure began to dissipate, the Demonic Path mist gradually retreating, leaving only her final words echoing in the air: 'During the Sect Competition three days from now, I will provide covert assistance.届时... whether to fight or reconcile, that's your choice.'

text.content: The moonlight remained cold and clear. Chen Ji stood before the window, the legacy of his father in his hand, yet his heart roiled like a churning sea. The seven-day agreement—he had thought it merely aprobing性接触 with the Demonic Path, never expecting such a profound scheme hidden behind. Father, sister, Chen Tianming, Ling Yuan... all clues pointed in the same direction—the Sect Competition three days from now. There would be the first turning point of this chess game. He lowered his gaze to the letter in his hand; his father's handwriting seemed alive under the moonlight, those earnest eyes looking at him across time and space. Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile carried a tinge of bitterness, but more determination. Since his father had long paved the way, this useless son would walk it for them to see.

He unfolded the second page of the silk scroll, and the Tianji Record's aura surged once more. This time, he saw the conditions for unsealing the third page—requiring complete comprehension of all knowledge on the second page, and... the heart blood of someone fate-linked to Chen Ji. Chen Ji's gaze shifted slightly; heart blood? This condition was ten times more stringent than the first page. But then small characters appeared on the scroll, making his pupils constrict—'Those sharing fate may bear it on behalf.' Sharing fate... He suddenly recalled Mo Xiansheng mentioning this term, and a guess formed in his heart. Three days—he needed to make a choice: face Chen Tianming alone, or find the person who could share fate with him? Or perhaps... walk both paths?

choice.prompt: Facing the clues his father left and the impending crisis in three days, Chen Ji needed to make a decision. Ye Qing had expressed she would provide covert assistance, but the initiative must remain in his own hands.

choices.text: Honor the seven-day agreement and meet in person
choices.description: Since his father had arranged everything in advance, why not turn the scheme to his advantage? Face Chen Tianming directly at the Sect Competition. Use the Tianji Record to foresee all variables at the competition site, arrange everything in advance, and transform passivity into initiative.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Chen Tianming's true Combat Power data
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will cause trouble at the competition; must prepare in advance
choices.process_label: use self as bait scheme tournament

dialogue.content: Chen Ji carefully secured the silk scroll and letter close to his body, his gaze regaining its icy composure. 'Since father has laid the chess pieces even to the Demonic Path, this useless son shall not disappoint him.' He murmured to himself, then sat cross-legged, closing his eyes and gathering his focus. The Tianji Record's aura surged within his Mental Sea as he began deducing all possibilities for the competition three days later. The seven-day agreement—he would honor it, just on his own terms.

choices.description: The Holy Sect behind Ye Qing has old ties with his father; why not leverage this for deeper cooperation? Use the Tianji Record to show her a prophecy concerning her own future, in exchange for the Holy Sect's full support three days later.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Holy Sect's intelligence network and covert support
choices.risk_hint: Revealing a portion of the Tianji Record's abilities may draw even greater covetous attention.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head, gazing toward the direction where Ye Qing had vanished, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. 'The Holy Sect owes my father a favor?' he murmured to himself. 'Then perhaps... let this favor grow larger.' Before his words even faded, his consciousness sank deep into the Tianji Record, beginning to search for the faint, elusive threads of Ye Qing's fate. He intended to make this Holy Sect Demoness understand—partnering with him was the most correct choice she would ever make in her life.

Three days later, the Sect Competition. Chen Ji stood at the edge of the Martial Arena, his expression calm as always, only the turtle shell clasped in his sleeve felt faintly warm. He had already deduced every possible variation of today through the Tianji Record more than a hundred times, each scenario meticulously calculated within his plans. Ling Yuan intended to make a move? Fine, I'll wait. Chen Tiangming wanted to appear? Even better. I truly wanted to see what this madman, who had pursued my father for half his life, was truly capable of. From a distance, a sharp gaze shot over—it was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. She seemed to have sensed something, her brow creased. Chen Ji met her eyes, giving a slight nod, his smile gentle like some useless fool.

choices.text: First save my sister, then discuss everything else.
choices.description: His father's letter mentioned his sister Chen Nian was in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. Though three days was tight, if he could collaborate deeply with Ye Qing, perhaps he could rescue his sister before the Sect Competition. His sister was the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key,' her existence could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight—this was both an advantage and a variable.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tiangming was determined to obtain his sister, rescuing her might prematurely expose his intentions.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at the words 'Nian'er still lives' on the letter, his heart pounding violently. Eighteen years—he had believed his sister had died in that upheaval long ago, never imagining she had been alive all along, hidden by his father in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. He was the elder brother, the sole male heir of the Chen family; protecting his sister was an instinct carved into his very blood and bone. 'Three days...' Chen Ji murmured, a flash of determination flickering in his eyes. 'Enough.' He rose, pushed open the door. Tonight, he would have Ye Qing lead him to meet his sister.

text.content: Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's silhouette gradually merged into the night. What he failed to notice was that on a pavilion elsewhere in the sect, a pair of clear yet scrutinizing eyes were tightly fixed on his retreating figure. Su Qingyao's elegant brow furrowed, her fingertips unconsciously rubbing the sword hilt. 'Going out late at night, acting secretive...' she murmured, a complex light flickering in her gaze. 'Chen Ji, what are you truly hiding?' Her form shimmered, following silently. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect was never one to wait passively. The Sect Competition in three days, she sensed, would bring significant events—and this junior brother she could never quite see through might be the key.

Meanwhile, in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, an aged figure stood beneath an ancient pine. Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, his turbid old eyes glinting with sinister light beneath the moon. 'Everything is proceeding according to plan.' Beside him, a black-robed figure reported quietly. Ling Yuan nodded slightly, a cold, sinister smile curling at his lips. 'Chen Xuan wronged me in the past, the Tianji Record abandoned me...' his voice was low as an abyss, 'Eighteen years of this humiliation—I shall have his son repay this debt. In three days, let us see just how long thistrash can keep hiding.' Before his words even faded, a gust of night wind passed by, and the old man's form actually dissipated like a specter. Only that ancient pine of a thousand years rustled in the wind, as if whispering some ominous premonition.

dialogue.content: Biting night wind howled as Chen Ji traveled through the sect's secret passages. Suddenly, his steps halted, a cold smile forming at the corner of his lips—within his spiritual sense, two auras were approaching, one icy cold like a serpent, the other cool and bright like the moon. Ling Yuan's scouts, and... Su Qingyao? Excellent, very good. He rapidly calculated in his mind: Ling Yuan's scouts were understandable, but why would Su Qingyao be tracking him at this late hour? Had she sensed something, or did she have ulterior motives? Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and he made a bold decision—he deliberately slowed his pace, even exposing some flaws, like a guilty thief. 'Want to watch a show?' he coldly thought in his heart, 'Then watch your fill.' Yet what even he didn't notice was the turtle shell in his sleeve growing faintly warm—that was the Tianji Record sending a warning—three days from now at the Sect Competition, the variables were even more numerous than he had imagined.

text.content: Just then, a ghostly purple light tore through the night sky, and Ye Qing's figure appeared before Chen Ji like a specter. Her expression was even graver than before, fine beads of sweat even appearing at her temples—it was clear she had强行返了回来 using some secret technique. 'Chen Ji, circumstances have changed.' she said in a low, rapid voice, 'Chen Tiangming has moved ahead of schedule. His advance team has already infiltrated the Tianqing Sect's territory, and their target... is your sister Chen Nian. There's a traitor inside the Holy Sect—your whereabouts have been exposed.' Before her words even finished, several blood-red signal flares suddenly lit up the distant night sky—that was the signal for a demonic path attack. Chen Ji's pupils sharply constricted—his father's laid-out chess game had actually been preemptively disrupted by someone moving the pieces?

choice.prompt: Chen Tiangming's people have already made their move, the situation has taken a sharp turn. Chen Ji must make an immediate choice—prioritize rescuing his sister, or stabilize the situation within the sect first? Or perhaps... is there another way to break the deadlock?

choices.description: Since the enemies are coming for my sister, turn the tables. Use the Tianji Record to foresee the advance team's specific location, rescue my sister before they succeed. This is an instinct to protect family, and also Chen Ji's bottom line.
choices.visible_reward: Siblings reunite, obtain sister's 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key' ability.
choices.risk_hint: Expose the Tianji Record's abilities, which may provoke Chen Tiangming's true body to act ahead of schedule.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned cold and sharp as a blade. 'Sister...' he said in a low voice, a never-before-seen killing intent flickering in his eyes. This person his father had guarded with his life—who dared touch her, he would make them die. The turtle shell in his palm violently trembled, the Tianji Record's aura surging madly—he could see it—the twelve assassins of the advance team were lying in ambush around the perimeter of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, merely a hundred zhang from the underground palace entrance where his sister was located. 'Let's go.' He uttered just this single word, his form already turning into a phantom shadow. Ye Qingwas momentarily stunned, then followed, a trace of a smile even appearing at the corner of her lips—this was the spirit Chen Xuan's son should possess.

Meanwhile, within the sect, Su Qingyao's form fluttered like a falling leaf to the spot where Chen Ji had just stood. She gazed at the empty secret passage, brow tightly knit. 'Escaped? Or...' Suddenly, her expression changed, catching a faint demonic path aura within her spiritual sense. 'Demonic path people?' she gasped, and without hesitation, followed that aura. Tonight, the sect was destined not to be peaceful. And she had a vague feeling that this useless junior brother she could never quite see through might actually be the eye of tonight's storm.

choices.text: Hold position, quietly observe the changes.
choices.description: Since the enemies are coming for my sister, it shows their scheme has fallen into disorder. Turn the tables by letting Chen Tiangming's people make the first move, while I sit back and reap the fisherman's benefit. Besides, acting rashly might play right into the enemy's trap.
choices.visible_reward: Clarify enemy layout, obtain intelligence advantage.
choices.risk_hint: "My sister may be in danger, I must bear the consequences."

dialogue.content: "Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly. 'Are you sure?' She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, trying to find a hint of hesitation, but only saw an abyss of calm. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, the moonlight outlining his lean profile, unable to conceal that terrifying steadiness. 'Since Chen Tianming dared to send people, it means he has something to rely on.' He said coolly, 'But what he doesn't know is that I've been waiting for this moment for eighteen years.' No emotional fluctuation could be heard in his voice, only a bone-deep coldness. Ye Qing suddenly understood why Chen Xuan had chosen this son as his inheritor—his temperament was far more terrifying than his cultivation."

"In the distance, the blood-red signal lights grew denser, and a low horn sounded through the night sky—the prelude to a Demonic Path attack. Yet at this moment, a cold sword light descended from the heavens, landing precisely between Chen Ji and Ye Qing. Su Qingyao held a long sword, her expression stern, the blade pointing directly at Ye Qing. 'Demonic Path witch, how dare you trespass the Tianqing Sect!' Her voice was clear and sharp, yet her gaze死死盯着陈机, 'Chen Ji, have you colluded with the Demonic Path?' Chen Ji looked at her, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting into a harmless smile: 'Senior Su, not sleeping at this late hour, following your junior brother around?' One sentence made Su Qingyao's expression even gloomier."

choices.text: "Turn the tables, counter-kill the advance team."
choices.description: "Since the enemy sent an advance team, let's make sure they never return. Use the Tianji Record to lock onto their positions, then have Ye Qing contact the Holy Sect to set up an ambush. This move can both save my sister and give Chen Tianming a sound lesson."
choices.visible_reward: "Annihilated the advance team, obtained Demonic Path classified intelligence."
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing's full cooperation is required—if she has any doubts, the plan may fall apart."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile so gentle it sent chills down one's spine. 'Ye Qing, do you trust me?' He turned to Ye Qing, his voice calm as if discussing something unrelated to life and death. Ye Qing froze for a moment, then nodded. 'The debt I owe your father—I haven't repaid it yet.' Chen Ji nodded in satisfaction, taking the Turtle Shell from his sleeve. The aura of the Tianji Record began to surge. 'Since Chen Tianming wants to play, I'll play a big game with him.' His voice was deep as an abyss, 'I want everyone he sends to become a message I write to him—destroy the enemy and crush their spirit, nothing more.' As the words fell, golden light blazed on the Turtle Shell, and Chen Ji began, at the cost of Heavenly Fate, to frantically deduce all movement routes and weaknesses of the advance team."

"Half an hour later, at the edge of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. The twelve assassins of the advance team had just entered the preset ambush point when they found the surrounding scenery suddenly distorting—it was Demonic Path mist, yet at this moment it was torn apart by an even more domineering force. 'Bad move, we've fallen into a trap!' The leading black-clad man hissed, but before his words finished, a sword light had already struck from the shadows, cleanly claiming the first life. Then, a rain of swords descended from the heavens, precise as if someone had informed them in advance of each person's location. 'Impossible...' The black-clad man's eyes widened, his voice cut short. In the distance, Ye Qing sheathed her blood-stained long sword, gazing at that figure standing under the moonlight, truly shaken for the first time—how terrifying was this man, really?"

text.content: "The battlefield quickly fell silent, twelve corpses lay scattered, only one person left alive by Chen Ji. He walked slowly toward that person, looking down at that terrified, twisted face. His lips carried a gentle smile, but his eyes were cold enough to chill one's bones. 'Go tell Chen Tianming,' his voice was light as a breeze, as if merely commenting on something trivial, 'the thing he wants is with me. If he wants it, come get it himself. At the Sect Competition in three days, I'll be waiting for him.' As the words fell, he raised his hand, and a blood-stained token landed beside the man—that was Chen Tianming's commander token, a trophy from the battlefield. The black-clad man's pupils constricted sharply. Thistrash... was actually this terrifying?!"

"After dealing with the advance team, Chen Ji turned to gaze into the depths of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. There, a faint yet familiar aura was calling to him—his sister, eighteen years had passed, and he was finally about to see her. However, the moment he stepped forward, a figure blocked his path—Ye Qing. Her expression was complicated, as if wanting to speak yet hesitating. 'Is there something else?' Chen Ji frowned. Ye Qing took a deep breath and finally spoke: 'Your sister... she's somewhat different.' She paused, choosing her words carefully, 'She's not just the Heavenly Fate Key; something is sealed within her—a final gift your father left for you. But that power is too overwhelming. Once released, the consequences would be unthinkable. Are you... ready?' Chen Ji's footsteps halted, his gaze deep as an abyss. His father's final gift to him... what exactly was it?"

"Moonlight poured down as Chen Ji stood at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds, before him a dark tunnel, behind him a battlefield just pacified. His hand slowly reached into his breast, touching that yellowed Letter. His father's voice seemed to echo through time: 'Ji'er, Father's greatest regret in this life is not witnessing you and Nian'er grow up...' Chen Ji closed his eyes briefly, then opened them again, his gaze now resolute. 'Whatever Father left behind, I will accept.' He murmured, then stepped into the tunnel. Ye Qing followed closely, the Demonic Path mist swirling around her, adding a touch of warmth to this dark passage. At the tunnel's end, a faint light flickered—that was the glow of a sealing formation. Chen Ji's heart raced violently. Eighteen years—his sister was right there waiting for him. What he didn't know was that the moment he entered the Forbidden Grounds, Chen Tianming, thousands of miles away, suddenly opened his eyes, a mad gleam flashing in his gaze—'Found it.'"

dialogue.content: "The sealing formation slowly dissipated, and a frail figure appeared before Chen Ji. She was a girl of fifteen or sixteen, with delicate features, her eyes and brows bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, though her skin was pallid to the point of translucence, as if she might be scattered by the wind at any moment. Her eyes were closed, faint Spiritual Light lingered around her body—traces of the seal not yet fully lifted. 'Nian'er...' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, his throat seeming blocked by something. Eighteen years—when had that little girl grown into a young maiden, imprisoned in this lightless place for all of eighteen years? The girl's eyelashes trembled slightly, as if awakened by some sound, and slowly opened her eyes. Those eyes were clear as water, yet the moment they saw Chen Ji, tears burst forth. 'Brother... Brother?' Her voice was faint and trembling, carrying disbelief mixed with wild joy, 'Is it really you?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji could no longer hold back, rushing forward in three strides to embrace his sister tightly. His body trembled slightly, eighteen years of longing, guilt, and worry all transforming in this moment into silent tears sliding down. 'It's me, it's Brother...' His voice choked, 'I'm sorry, Nian'er, Brother came late, making you suffer so much alone here...' Chen Nian lay in his embrace, her frail body shaking violently, tears soaking his clothes. 'I knew it... I knew Brother would come to save me...' She sobbed breathlessly, 'Father said Brother would definitely come... he told me to wait, no matter what happens, to wait...' Ye Qing stood quietly to the side, watching this pair of siblings reuniting after disaster, her eyes unexpectedly growing moist. Chen Xuan, you really did... plan everything down to the last detail, even anticipating this moment?"

"After a long while, Chen Ji finally released his sister, carefully studying her face. Eighteen years apart, that little girl had grown into a young lady. In her eyes and brows, traces of her former childishness could still be faintly seen, but there was also a composure not belonging to her age. 'Nian'er, tell Brother, all these years... how did you get by?' His voice was gentle, afraid of disturbing anything. Chen Nian wiped her tears, trying to calm her emotions. 'There was the protective formation Father left behind, and also...' She paused, her gaze falling on her own heart, 'a voice that has been protecting me all along. Father said it was the final gift for me, to be given to Brother when he arrived.' With that, she slowly raised her hand, pressing it against her heart. A warm Jade Slip slowly emerged—the characters 'Ji' clearly carved upon it—her father's handwriting. Chen Ji's breath quickened sharply. Father's... final gift?"

"Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, and the moment his fingertips touched it, a familiar aura flooded into his Mental Sea. It was a segment of sealed memory, carrying his father's final bequest before his death. In the vision, Chen Xuan was covered in blood, yet still wore a gentle smile. 'Ji'er, when you see this memory, Father should already be gone from this world.' He paused, his expression growing grave, 'The complete form of the Tianji Record is far more terrifying than you imagine. It is not merely a method of prophecy, but...' He took a deep breath, 'the eye of Heavenly Fate's will in this world. Every prophecy-holder throughout history, including Father, was merely a piece on its chessboard. Father's entire life was spent trying to escape its control, yet ultimately, he failed.' In the vision, Chen Xuan suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of liberation, 'But Father found another path—the true Tianji Record lies not in prediction, but in rewriting. Ji'er, Father has placed his final hope in Nian'er. What is sealed within her... is your first step toward escaping Heavenly Fate.'"

"The memory ended abruptly, yet Chen Ji could not回过神来 for a long time. His father's words were like a thunderclap exploding in his mind. The complete form of the Tianji Record... was the eye of Heavenly Fate's will? Were all prophecy-holders pieces on a chessboard? Then everything he was doing now... had it already been seen by that eye? A chill rose from his spine, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He suddenly looked up at Ye Qing. 'You said Chen Tianming intends to deal with me... what is his true purpose?' Ye Qing's expression also turned grave. 'According to Holy Sect intelligence, he has been pursuing the Tianji Record for more than half his life. It's said he wants...' She paused, uttering four words, 'to take its place.' Chen Ji's breath caught. To take its place... to replace the Tianji Record, become the new piece of Heavenly Fate's will? No, what was more terrifying—Chen Tianming wanted to become the new Heavenly Fate itself!"

"Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing the surging emotions down. Though his father's words were shocking, they also solved a long-standing doubt in his heart—why did every use of the Tianji Record consume Heavenly Fate? That was not a simple price, but... Heavenly Fate's will reclaiming its chess piece. As long as he continued using the Tianji Record, he would never escape that eye's observation. And Chen Tianming... perhaps precisely because he saw through this, he pursued Chen Ji so unscrupulously. He didn't want to kill Chen Ji, but to seize the Tianji Record's inheritance, then... completely escape Heavenly Fate's control and become the one who moves the pieces. 'What grand ambition.' Chen Ji coldly declared, a cold light flickering in his eyes, 'Since that's the case, let's see in the end who moves the pieces and who becomes the piece.' As the words fell, he gripped the Jade Slip tightly, his resolve already set. At the Sect Competition in three days, he would no longer hold anything back. The path his father paved, he would walk it; the path his father didn't finish, he would complete!"

"That yellowed密信 lay quietly in Ye Qing's palm, the familiar handwriting upon it making Chen Ji's breath hitch—Father had calculated today's events eighteen years ago; his contingency plans were far more than this. The characters on the密信 were clear and forceful, Chen Xuan's own handwriting: 'Ji'er, when you read this letter, Father will have been gone for eighteen years. Father's greatest regret in this life is not witnessing you two siblings grow into adulthood. But Father believes that Ji'er, you will surely take care of Nian'er. The truth of the Tianji Record is explained in detail in the Jade Slip, so Father won't repeat it here. Only remind you of one thing—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible; it too has weaknesses. Find that weakness, and you can completely rewrite fate. Also, the seal within Nian'er, absolutely do not解除 it casually—that is a double-edged sword; the slightest carelessness will cause it to turn against you. Father has left you a护心丹 hidden within the Jade Pendant Nian'er always wears. In critical moments, it can protect your life. My son, Father has no regrets in this life, only对不起 you two siblings. If fate allows us to meet in another life, let us be father and son again. Father.'"
